sql_text: SELECT symbol, activity_score, score_status, event_component_source FROM analysis.analysis_stock_activity WHERE as_of_date <= ? ORDER BY activity_score DESC NULLS LAST, symbol
limitations: descriptive research output; empty result is valid

sql_text: WITH ranked AS (SELECT symbol, trade_date, close_qfq, volume_ratio_20, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM feat_price_daily WHERE trade_date <= ?) SELECT symbol, trade_date, close_qfq, volume_ratio_20 FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND volume_ratio_20>=1.5 ORDER BY volume_ratio_20 DESC, symbol
limitations: descriptive research output; empty result is valid

sql_text: WITH ranked AS (SELECT symbol, trade_date, box_width_40, trend_slope_40, r_squared_40, style_label, style_confidence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM feat_style_daily WHERE trade_date <= ?) SELECT symbol, trade_date, box_width_40, trend_slope_40, r_squared_40, style_label, style_confidence FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY box_width_40 ASC NULLS LAST, symbol
limitations: descriptive research output; empty result is valid
